reference.quote: THAT THE INDIVIDUAL IS UNDER EIGHTEEN YEARS OF AGE
reference.value: age < 18 (actual knowledge or reasonable certainty): minor / minor account holder, scope of the minor protections in 18-802

reference.quote: AT THE BEGINNING OF EACH SESSION AND APPEARING AT LEAST EVERY THREE HOURS IN A CONTINUOUS CONVERSATIONAL AI SERVICE INTERACTION
reference.value: 3 hours of continuous interaction: AI disclosure to minor must reappear (if not a persistent disclaimer)

reference.quote: IF THE ACCOUNT HOLDER IS UNDER THIRTEEN YEARS OF AGE, THE ACCOUNT HOLDER'S PARENT OR GUARDIAN
reference.value: age < 13: privacy/account-setting tools must be offered to the parent or guardian; age >= 13: related tools to parent as appropriate

reference.quote: is effective from and after September 30, 2027
reference.value: 2027-09-30 effective date of A.R.S. Title 18, ch. 8

thresholds.note: >= 13: related tools to parent as appropriate; distinct consequence from row 1, not a duplicate

X.note: minors_child_safety primary fits; generative_ai (conversational AI) and consumer_protection (consumer notices) defensible.

reference_scope: full text (Tier B: thresholds and key dates only)
notes: Tier B. X and Y are near-identical. Both miss the 3-hour re-disclosure interval in 18-802(A)(2) (counted as a threshold in the reference: duty re-triggers after 3 hours of continuous interaction; arguably a duty frequency, so the miss is minor). Penalty amounts in 18-802(I) are enforcement and not in the Tier B reference; neither version codes them as thresholds.
